findingClass: a `.toISOString()` string bound to a drizzle query-builder operator (eq/ne/gt/gte/lt/lte/between/inArray/notInArray) or a `.set()`/`.values()` field whose column is a drizzle `timestamp()` column in default (Date) mode. Drizzle's PgTimestamp.mapToDriverValue calls `.toISOString()` on whatever value it receives, so a string throws `TypeError: value.toISOString is not a function` at query time — the opposite failure mode from the raw node-postgres path, where binding the string IS correct (docs/reviews/failure-classes/iso-string-bound-to-drizzle-timestamp.json, #954).
failThreshold: scripts/ci/check-drizzle-iso-string.mjs exits 1 whenever it finds a NEW `.toISOString()` call bound to a drizzle operator or write field on a column it classifies as default-mode timestamp() (every declaration of that JS property name across packages/shared/src/db/schema.ts is timestamp() with no `mode: 'string'`) — a `date()` column or a `mode: 'string'` timestamp is never flagged, and a name declared ambiguously (both ways, anywhere) is skipped rather than risk a false positive on the PR gate. `.toISOString()` written inside a `sql`` template (the raw-pg path) is stripped before scanning and never flagged. Offenders are diffed against the committed baseline scripts/ci/drizzle-iso-string-baseline.json (empty; may only shrink), so any NEW offender fails the gate while pre-existing exemptions (none currently) do not re-fail on every PR.
unverifiableWhen: n/a — this is a CI gate, not a nightly audit check; it either runs (every PR touching the `gate` job) or does not run at all.
note: IMPLEMENTED: scripts/ci/check-drizzle-iso-string.mjs is wired into .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml's `gate` job and has a mutation-proof self-test (scripts/tests/check-drizzle-iso-string.test.mjs) that is RED on a planted `gte(ipos.createdAt, d.toISOString())` against a synthetic default-mode timestamp column, and GREEN on `gte(ipos.createdAt, d)`, on `sql`${d.toISOString()}``, on a `date()` column, and on a `mode: 'string'` timestamp column. Verified against the real tree 2026-09-25: 0 offenders (the #1069/#1067 fixes already removed the two known instances). This runs on every PR (the check-in-time gate), not the nightly floor, so it stays in notCoveredByThisManifest per docs/reviews/detection-checks/_meta.json's schema note — the same reason manifest_generator_drift.json is filed here rather than under "checks".
owner: Landed 2026-09-25 (Q4, owner approved). Consumer: the PR gate (`gate` job, .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml). This check protects the BINDING CONTRACT (a value's JS type matches the layer that will consume it — raw pg parameter vs drizzle-mapped column) for `timestamp()` columns specifically; it does not (and cannot, statically) verify the VALUE itself is correct IST-converted data — that is the ist-timezone.md round-trip proof's job, run separately.
